title: Cycling
description: Cycling training view (core.sport.discipline = 'bike': cycling / virtual_cycling). Only 29 bike sessions exist; power is present only on home-trainer (virtual_cycling) rides because the athlete has no power meter on the road bike.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

target.rawSql: SELECT n.local_date::timestamp AS time, n.kind AS text, n.kind AS tags FROM core.note n WHERE n.athlete_id = $athlete_id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly volume
panels.description: core.activity, duration_s summed per ISO week (hours), split by core.sport.is_indoor into Indoor (virtual_cycling, home trainer) and Outdoor (cycling, road). is_parent = false to avoid double-counting triathlon legs. This is the primary view of the discipline since most bike work happens on the trainer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.duration_s)/3600.0 AS value, CASE WHEN s.is_indoor THEN 'Indoor' ELSE 'Outdoor' END AS metric FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly distance
panels.description: core.activity.distance_m summed per ISO week (km), split Indoor/Outdoor on core.sport.is_indoor. Virtual-cycling distance is simulated by the trainer software, not GPS-measured -- treat the Indoor series as an estimate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.distance_m)/1000.0 AS value, CASE WHEN s.is_indoor THEN 'Indoor' ELSE 'Outdoor' END AS metric FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly TSS
panels.description: mart.activity_wide.tss for bike sessions, summed per ISO week (bars, left axis). The 'Missing RPE' series (right axis) counts sessions with needs_manual_rpe = true that week, so a low TSS week caused by an unentered RPE is visible instead of silently understated. Scoped via JOIN to core.activity (mart.activity_wide has no athlete_id) and is_parent = false.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', w.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(w.tss) AS "TSS" FROM mart.activity_wide w JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = w.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = w.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', w.local_date)::timestamp AS time, count(*) AS "Missing RPE" FROM mart.activity_wide w JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = w.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = w.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND w.needs_manual_rpe = true AND $__timeFilter(w.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Normalised power and intensity factor per session
panels.description: mart.activity_wide, one point per bike session with np_watts IS NOT NULL. NP (left axis, watts) is restricted to np_reliable = true -- unreliable NP values (too few power samples) are excluded rather than plotted. Intensity Factor (right axis, unitless) uses the same session set. FTP is overlaid as a flat reference line read live from core.threshold (discipline = 'bike', currently-valid row); it is never hardcoded. Because only home-trainer rides carry power, every point here is an indoor session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, w.np_watts AS "NP (W)" FROM mart.activity_wide w JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = w.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = w.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND w.np_watts IS NOT NULL AND w.np_reliable = true AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, w.intensity_factor AS "Intensity Factor" FROM mart.activity_wide w JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = w.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = w.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND w.np_watts IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS time, t.ftp_watts AS "FTP (W)" FROM core.threshold t WHERE t.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND t.discipline = 'bike' AND upper_inf(t.validity) UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamp AS time, t.ftp_watts AS "FTP (W)" FROM core.threshold t WHERE t.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND t.discipline = 'bike' AND upper_inf(t.validity) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Power duration curve
panels.description: mart.power_curve_best, kind = 'bike_power': best average power per duration, one curve per lookback window (last 28 / 90 / 365 days, all time), computed from current date regardless of the dashboard time picker. This view has no athlete_id and no sport_code, so scope comes entirely from JOIN core.activity ON activity_id (is_parent = false). All curves are necessarily built from indoor sessions since outdoor rides carry no power.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "Last 28 days (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id WHERE pc.kind = 'bike_power' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND pc.local_date >= (current_date - interval '28 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "Last 90 days (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id WHERE pc.kind = 'bike_power' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND pc.local_date >= (current_date - interval '90 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "Last 365 days (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id WHERE pc.kind = 'bike_power' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND pc.local_date >= (current_date - interval '365 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "All time (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id WHERE pc.kind = 'bike_power' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time in power zones, weekly
panels.description: mart.power_pace_zone_time, zone_system = 'power_pct_ftp', seconds summed per ISO week and zone (Z1-Z5, stacked bars, hours). No athlete_id on this view: scoped via JOIN core.activity (is_parent = false) and core.sport (discipline = 'bike'). Power zones only exist for sessions with power, i.e. essentially the indoor home-trainer rides -- this panel is near-empty for outdoor weeks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', pz.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(pz.seconds)/3600.0 AS value, pz.zone_code AS metric FROM mart.power_pace_zone_time pz JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pz.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE pz.zone_system = 'power_pct_ftp' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND $__timeFilter(pz.local_date) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time in HR zones, weekly
panels.description: mart.hr_zone_time, seconds summed per ISO week and zone (Z1-Z5, %LTHR based, stacked bars, hours). No athlete_id on this view: scoped via JOIN core.activity (is_parent = false) and core.sport on sport_code, filtered to discipline = 'bike' (never sport_code = 'bike', that value does not exist). Unlike the power-zone panel, this one also covers outdoor rides that have no power.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', hz.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(hz.seconds)/3600.0 AS value, hz.zone_code AS metric FROM mart.hr_zone_time hz JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = hz.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = hz.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'bike' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND $__timeFilter(hz.local_date) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly ascent
panels.description: core.activity.ascent_m summed per ISO week (metres), outdoor rides only (core.sport.is_indoor = false, discipline = 'bike'). Indoor ascent is trainer-simulated (e.g. simulated climbs in structured workouts) and not comparable to real elevation gain, so it is excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.ascent_m) AS "Ascent (m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND s.is_indoor = false AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent rides
panels.description: core.activity joined to core.sport (discipline = 'bike', label shows Cycling vs Virtual cycling so indoor/outdoor is obvious) and left-joined to mart.activity_wide for tss/tss_method/np/intensity factor, most recent first, time-range filtered on local_date. data_quality and tss_method are shown deliberately so the athlete can judge how much to trust each row (data_quality = unknown means summary-only CSV import, no streams).

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.local_date AS "Date", s.label AS "Sport", a.name AS "Name", round(a.duration_s/60.0, 1) AS "Duration (min)", round((a.distance_m/1000.0)::numeric, 2) AS "Distance (km)", a.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", a.avg_power AS "Avg Power (W)", w.np_watts AS "NP (W)", w.intensity_factor AS "IF", w.tss AS "TSS", w.tss_method AS "TSS Method", a.data_quality AS "Data Quality" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code LEFT JOIN mart.activity_wide w ON w.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'bike' AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY a.local_date DESC
